messages:
leah.partnerships: Quick heads-up 1: planning marketplace launch readiness + joint GTM for cloud + hardware partners. Target embargo 2025-11-18 15:00 PT. Need: press one-pager, blog draft, Figma hero (with two hardware badges), SI onboarding checklist, and tenant provisioning notes by EOD Wed. @mike_gTM @tess_prod @owen_engineering

mike_gTM: Copy. I'll draft a concise headline + TL;DR and reach out to partner comms for quotes. Expect first pass by tomorrow AM.

tess_prod: On SI checklist: I'll assemble items for KMS flow, network requirements for private deployments, and runbook steps for SI handoffs. Need the sample manifest and auth details from eng.

owen_engineering: Manifest and minimal auth snippet attached here:

```
integration: redwood-marketplace
manifest_version: 1
auth: oauth2
endpoints:
  - /v1/generate
  - /v1/embeddings
```

owen_engineering: Also put a preview of the landing page on staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace-preview-2025 (feedback welcome).

rachel_ops: Staging preview loads. Ops checklist note: tenant provisioning for reserved capacity requires 72h lead time for hardware-backed offerings. Add that to marketplace metadata.

leah.partnerships: Good catch. Partners want a short co-sell blurb under the hero and a small footnote about certified hardware ("Runs on PartnerX certified accelerators"). Can we make the hero subhead: "Predictable latency. Measured economics." Suggestions?

mike_gTM: I like "Predictable latency. Measured economics." For CTA, propose: "Try Redwood Inference on Marketplace" instead of generic copy.

tess_prod: SI items I'll include:
- On-prem install checklist
- KMS/HSM integration steps
- Network egress rules and firewall example
- SAML/OIDC notes for tenant access
- Rollback and rollback verification steps
I'll upload a template by EOD.

owen_engineering: Small tech governance ask: include a note in listing about model fallback behavior (e.g., "Default routing to rwd-large, fallback to rwd-medium under load") so buyers understand tradeoffs. I'll add the fallback mapping to the metadata YAML.

rachel_ops: Ops also needs legal-confirmed SLA blurb for marketplace page. I'll flag legal and set a 48h turnaround request.

announce-bot: DRY RUN SCHEDULED: dr-1769999  2025-11-16T09:30:00-08:00  Participants: leah.partnerships, mike_gTM, tess_prod, owen_engineering, rachel_ops

leah.partnerships: Timeline proposal:
- Tue AM: blog draft + hero PNG + partner quote slots
- Tue PM: SI checklist draft + manifest in repo
- Wed AM: press one-pager + embargo PDF to PR/legal
- Thu AM: final assets integrated on staging + dry run
- Tue (launch week): publish post-embargo and enable marketplace listing

mike_gTM: I'll coordinate with partner comms to confirm quotes and logo usage. Need logos in SVG by Tue PM.

owen_engineering: Noted. Will add manifest + routing/fallback notes to repo and ping CI to validate manifest schema.

tess_prod: Uploading SI template: https://drive.google.com/si-onprem-template (perms set to partners-read).

rachel_ops: I've created a marketplace metadata checklist doc and linked it to the staging page. Also created onboarding ticket template for reserved tenants.

leah.partnerships: If no major blockers, I'll collect assets and send embargo request to legal tomorrow. Please flag anything blocking today. :white_check_mark:

mike_gTM: No blockers from comms side. Will share draft by 10am PT.

owen_engineering: Nothing blocking, will push fallback mapping in 30m.

announce-bot: REMINDER: Dry run in ~48 hours (2025-11-16 09:30 PT). RSVP in #release-war-room.
